svg.title: The road so far: from computer science in India to robotics in the USA and back to research in India
svg.desc: B.Tech in computer science 2014 to 2018; research intern at DRDO 2017 to 2018; data scientist at e-Zest 2019 to 2020; M.S. Robotics at ASU 2021 to 2022; robotics engineer at Wheel.me 2023 to 2025; independent researcher from 2025; research software engineer at D. Y. Patil from 2026.

g.text: D. Y. Patil, clinical gait study
